corrections: (a) 跳点归因 — 修正前:「两个跳点=2011 抑郁筛查建议与 2016-10 编码指令」。修正后:2011 与 2016-10 是**政策日期**,论文观察到的**数据折点是 2012 与 2016–2017**。摘要原文:"a rise in 2012 followed changes in screening recommendations, while a sharp rise in 2016-2017 followed changes in the coding of suicidal ideation"。正文另有 "suicide-related visits clearly tick up after 2011, and again after 2016",两种表述并存,但引用时不应把政策年当成折点年。WPSG 保险覆盖实际生效于 "plan years starting on or after August 1, 2012"。

(a) 自杀完成率的数据来源 — 修正前:「新泽西医院数据…自杀完成率 essentially flat」。修正后:completed suicides **不来自医院数据**,来自另一来源(New Jersey Department of Families and Children 2016 生命统计),两条序列量纲差异巨大(2014 年 2.9/10万 vs 约 431/10万 就诊),论文将二者各自归一化到 2008=1 才作比较。正文措辞也弱于「flat」:"Completed suicides among teens in New Jersey do not show a clear trend over this period",并承认 "Those in the northeast region as a whole show some upward movement between 2015 and 2017"。
(a) 人群口径 — 补充:样本为**10–18 岁**新泽西全部住院+急诊记录,2008–2019(claim 未给年龄段)。
(a) 「涨幅主要来自自杀意念」可以更精确 — 修正后:出现趋势断裂的是**作为次要诊断的**自杀意念;SI 作为主要诊断只是 "trend[s] upwards gently and smoothly"。量化:2014/15→2018/19 每万青少年就诊增加 25.3,其中 **24.9 来自 SI,18.5 为次要诊断**。

(b) Psychiatric Services 2017 引语的适用范围 — 修正前:被当作「ICD-10 切换使自伤就医率虚增」的通用背书。修正后:逐字原文为 "Marked changes in coding of **intent** for injuries and poisonings during the fall of 2015 almost certainly represent artifacts of coding changes rather than true changes in suicidal behavior." 其所指是 self-inflicted 与 undetermined-intent 之间的**意图归类互换**,不是自伤总量。且该文是**十个** MHRN 系统的全体参保人(非仅青少年)、单位为 **每万参保人**、体裁为一页 Datapoints 专栏,仅描述性判断("appeared to increase abruptly"),无正式统计检验。

(b) 关键方向性修正 — 修正前:把 ICD-10 跳变读作单向「虚增」。修正后:Stewart 2017 的自伤编码上升被 undetermined-intent 编码**下降所抵消**;Currie 论文自己的总结是 "The net result that the total number of visits involving intentional self-harm remained largely unchanged around the October 2015 adoption point (Stewart et al., 2017, 2019; Zima et al., 2020)"。后续文献进一步把它读作**测准度改善**而非虚增(Sentinel 2023:"better ascertainment of intentional self-harm, rather than an actual change in incidence of suicidal behavior")。即伪影在**切换前的低估**一侧,+38.5 大部分是重新归类,不能等同于「真实率没变但报告虚增」。

(b) 来源独立性 — 修正前:PS 2017 与 Acad Pediatr 2026 被并列为两条互证线索。修正后:**二者非独立**。Christine Stewart 同时是两篇的作者;均出自 Mental Health Research Network / Kaiser Permanente 体系,系统集合高度重叠(2017 为 10 个,2026 为 9 个)。应作为同一研究组的前后续作引用。COI:Penfold 声明其机构收受 SAGE Therapeutics 与 Lundbeck Foundation 研究经费(与编码伪影议题相关性低,但需披露)。
(b) 统计量与外推 — 补充:ITS 窗口仅为切换**前后各 15 个月**;+6.5/10万/月若真「sustained」,15 个月累计即约 +97/10万,不可能是长期稳定参数,只能读作短窗口内的分段回归斜率。另 6–11 岁组仅有斜率变化 0.18/10万/月、**无即时跳变**报告。

(c) 「匿名调查不受伪影影响」— 修正前:作为既定判断陈述。修正后:该句**无一手来源支撑,且过强**。正确表述是:YRBS/MTF/NSDUH 不受**临床筛查与 ICD 编码**伪影影响,但并非无测量伪影。反证:SAMHSA 就 2021 NSDUH 明示 "changes in survey methodology mean the indicators are not comparable to past NSDUH estimates",并因此不再发布跨年趋势表——NSDUH 无法承载跨 2020–21 的连续趋势。此外 (c) 与 (d) 在逻辑上冲突:(d) 之所以存在,正因为「匿名自评的报告行为可能漂移」是一个需要检验而非可以假定的命题。

(d) 核心表述错误 — 修正前:「**校正**测量不变性后女生上升仍在」。修正后:该研究并未做「校正」,而是**检验后发现不变性成立**:"Across most conditions, the instrument was found measurement invariant across time. The few noninvariant parameters detected had negligible impact on trend estimates." 结论是 "the notion that changed reporting of symptoms has been an important driver of secular trends in depressive symptoms was not supported"。
(d) 构念错配 — 修正前:置于自伤/自杀测量伪影论证链中。修正后:该研究测的是**抑郁症状**(Kandel & Davies 六题 Depressive Mood Inventory),**不是自伤或自杀行为**。用它支撑自杀相关趋势属跨构念外推。

(d) 时间窗与样本 — 修正前:「2010-2019 女生上升」。修正后:女生潜均值上升是**从 2014 起**("From 2014, latent mean depressive symptom scores increased among girls"),非全窗口;男生 U 形为先降、**自 2016 起回升**。样本 N=560,712,**13–19 岁**,Psychol Med 2024 Oct;54(14):3949-3961。
(d) 被略去的反向限定 — 补充:论文明确指出 "Larger issues of noninvariance were found across age in girls and between genders"。即**跨性别与跨年龄比较恰恰是最不可靠的部分**——而 (d) 的论证方式(女生 vs 男生对比)正好踩在这一弱点上。

PS 2017 同文其余关键句:"We used data from ten health systems in the Mental Health Research Network (MHRN)";"Diagnoses of self-inflicted injury or poisoning appeared to increase abruptly with the coding transition, and this pattern was consistent across health systems";"Diagnoses of injury or poisoning of undetermined intent appeared to decrease with the coding transition, but this pattern varied considerably across health care systems";单位为 "monthly rates of injury or poisoning per 10,000 enrolled members"。

(a) 必须补上作者自陈的外推限制:新泽西在自杀完成率上不具全国代表性。脚注 1 原文:"youth suicides rose nationally but not in New Jersey",NJ 枪支自杀排第 48 位、属全美青少年自杀率最低的五个州之一,作者称 "regionally specific factors are driving much of the overall increase in teen suicides"。因此「自杀完成率 essentially flat」是 NJ 的事实,不能用来论证全国自杀上升是伪影;作者只主张「报告量的上升在全国是类似的」。

(b)/(a) 交叉印证机制:Currie 文中对 2015-10 切换的定性是意图重新归类而非净增,并同时引用 Stewart 2017、Stewart 2019、Zima 2020 三篇——说明「ICD-10 切换本身」与「2016-10 指令反转」是两个应当分开处理的事件,论断把二者并置在 (b) 项下时须避免混同。

同一篇的切换前基线月率未取得,因此无法判断 38.5/10万 的即时跳变相对基线是多大幅度(是小幅还是接近翻倍),也就无法评估它与 Stewart 2017「净量基本未变」之间张力的实际大小。这是本组证据里最需要补一手全文的缺口。
Psychiatric Services 2017 的引语虽取得完整原句,但未能在出版方页面或存档快照上逐字比对(Psychiatry Online 403、web.archive.org 被工具禁止访问、DuckDuckGo 触发验证码)。引语来自 Google Scholar 单一索引来源,未达到「2 个以上独立镜像」的标准。
该 Datapoints 专栏的具体数值(ICD-10 前后自伤/自杀未遂编码率的实际数字)未取得,故无法核实其结论强度是否支撑论断赋予它的分量。
本次会话 WebSearch 配额(200/200)在任务开始时即已耗尽,全程只能用 WebFetch 直接取址,无法做广度检索来搜寻针对上述四项的后续勘误、评论文章或反驳性再分析。因此「有无后续修正/勘误」这一项实质未能覆盖。

claim_id: measurement-artifact-bidirectional (测量伪影双向证据 a/b/c/d)
corrections: (a) 跳点年份错位。修正前:「两个跳点=2011 抑郁筛查建议与 2016-10 编码指令」。修正后:JHR 摘要逐字为「we investigate two inflection points in adolescent suicide-related visits and show that a rise in 2012 followed changes in screening recommendations, while a sharp rise in 2016–2017 followed changes in the coding of suicidal ideation」——数据上的拐点是 2012 与 2016–2017,2011 / 2016-10 是被指认的制度诱因日期,不是拐点本身。原表述把「制度日期」当成了「跳点日期」。

(a) USPSTF 建议年份错。修正前:「2011 抑郁筛查建议」。修正后:USPSTF 青少年(12–18 岁)抑郁筛查 B 级建议发布于 2009-03-15;2011 只是保险被强制承保的起点。JHR 正文逐字:「In 2009, the USPSTF recommended that providers screen adolescents 12–18 for depression. However, insurers were not required to pay for these services until 2011」。

(a) 年龄段与数据口径需补。修正前:「新泽西 2008-2019 医院数据」。修正后:对象是 10–18 岁(非 12–17),数据为全州住院出院记录 + 急诊就诊记录,2008–2019。定量口径:2014–2015 → 2018–2019 自杀相关编码就诊增长 50%,其中「the bulk of this increase, 24.9 out of 25.3 visits, was due to an increase in diagnoses of suicidal ideation」。

(a) 「flat」适用范围需分层。修正前:「自伤/自杀未遂/自杀完成率 essentially flat」。修正后:摘要确为「Rates of other suicidal behaviors, including self-harm, attempted suicides, and completed suicides were essentially flat over this period」(逐字成立);但正文对完成自杀用的是更弱的措辞「Completed suicides among teens in New Jersey do not show a clear trend over this period」——是「无明显趋势」而非严格持平。

(b) 效应符号是外推,不是原文。修正前:「即时跳变 +38.5/10 万、斜率 +6.5/10 万/月」。修正后:Academic Pediatrics 2026 摘要逐字为「There was an immediate 38.5 per 100,000 youths change in medically attended deliberate self-harm and a sustained 6.5 per 100,000 per month (slope) change in the 12-17 age group」——原文只写 change,不带正负号,也未给置信区间或 p 值。PubMed 与 Europe PMC 两处独立取得的摘要文本一致。引用时应去掉「+」或明确标注方向未在摘要中给出。
(b) 漏报 6–11 岁结果与窗口长度。修正后应补:6–11 岁仅有斜率变化 0.18/10 万/月、无即时跳变;ITS 窗口是 2015-10 前后各 15 个月,「6.5/10 万/月」只在该 30 个月窗口内成立(若外推等于 78/10 万/年),不可当作长期斜率。

(b) 与 (a) 并置存在实质张力,须点明。修正后:JHR 论文自己转述同一批作者的 2015-10 切换研究结论是「The adoption of the ICD-10 in October 2015 ... increased the number of injury and poisoning visits coded as self-harm and decreased the number of visits with "undetermined intent." The net result was that the total number of visits involving intentional self-harm remained largely unchanged around the October 2015 adoption point」。即 2015-10 主要是成分重分配、净量基本不变;而 (b) 主张 12–17 岁蓄意自伤即时跳变 38.5/10 万。两者口径不同(全人群 vs 12–17 岁;是否吸收 undetermined intent;州级全量 vs 九个医疗系统会员),不能当作同一结论叠加使用。

(c) 「匿名调查不受伪影影响」过强,应降级为「不受临床筛查与诊断编码这两类伪影影响,但有自身的测量伪影」。硬反证:NSDUH 2021 详表明确写「Unlike previous NSDUH detailed tables, there are no trend tables comparing estimates to previous years for 2021」,原因是「changes in survey methodology mean the indicators are not comparable to past NSDUH estimates」。另有内部矛盾:(d) 这篇论文本身就是在检验匿名调查的测量不变性——若匿名调查天然免疫伪影,该研究无从立题。

(d) 构念与时间窗需限定。修正前:「校正测量不变性后女生上升仍在、男生 U 形」。修正后:构念是抑郁症状(Kandel & Davies 六项 Depressive Mood Inventory),不是广义心理健康;13–19 岁、2010–2019、560,712 份作答;女生是「From 2014, latent mean depressive symptom scores increased among girls」(2014 年起,非全窗上升);男生「an initial decrease in symptoms was followed by an increase from 2016」。且论文同时报告「Larger issues of noninvariance were found across age in girls and between genders」——跨时间可比,但跨年龄(女生)与跨性别比较受影响,不能说「测量不变性全过关」。

(d) 在框架中的角色应标明为反向证据。该文结论逐字为「the notion that changed reporting of symptoms has been an important driver of secular trends in depressive symptoms was not supported」——它否证的是测量伪影解释,与 (a)(b) 方向相反。这正是「双向」成立之处,但原论断把四项并列陈述,读者易误读为四项同向支持伪影解释。
evidence_notes: JHR 摘要逐字(https://jhr.uwpress.org/content/59/S/S14):Corredor-Waldron A, Currie J.「To What Extent Are Trends in Teen Mental Health Driven by Changes in Reporting? The Example of Suicide-Related Hospital Visits」J Human Resources 2024;59(S):S14–S40, DOI 10.3368/jhr.0423-12854R1。关键句:「Using data on all hospital visits in New Jersey for 2008–2019, we investigate two inflection points ... a rise in 2012 followed changes in screening recommendations, while a sharp rise in 2016–2017 followed changes in the coding of suicidal ideation. Rates of other suicidal behaviors, including self-harm, attempted suicides, and completed suicides were essentially flat over this period.」资助方:NOMIS Foundation 与普林斯顿 Center for Health and Wellbeing;作者声明无利益冲突。

JHR 正文(https://jhr.uwpress.org/content/59/S/S14.full):样本为「children aged 10–18 in New Jersey between 2008 and 2019」;「Between 2014–2015 and 2018–2019 the number of visits with a suicide-related code grew by 50 percent」;「the bulk of this increase, 24.9 out of 25.3 visits, was due to an increase in diagnoses of suicidal ideation」;2016-10 变化为「clinicians were now actively encouraged to include symptoms such as suicidal ideation as secondary diagnoses when present with a primary diagnosis of mental illness」;并明确「there was no significant rise in the use of suicide-related diagnoses between 2015 and 2016」——即 2015-10 的 ICD-10 采用在 NJ 未产生跳变,跳变发生在 2016-10 指令修订之后。全文不含 “artifact” 一词。

Academic Pediatrics 2026 摘要,两处独立核对一致(https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/42002139/ 与 Europe PMC EXT_ID:42002139,https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/search?query=EXT_ID:42002139&resultType=core&format=json):Ryan TC, Angerhofer JE, Stewart C, Rossom RC, Harry ML, Ahmedani BK, Lynch FL, Beck A, Owen-Smith A, Daida YG, Coleman KJ, Penfold RB.「Impact of the Transition from ICD9-CM to ICD10-CM on Measuring Rates of Child and Adolescent Self-harm in Nine Health Systems」Acad Pediatr 2026 Apr, DOI 10.1016/j.acap.2026.103327。方法逐字:「interrupted time series (ITS) analyses on monthly rates of medically attended deliberate self-harm in the 15 months prior to and 15 months following the transition to ICD10 in October 2015 across nine health systems ... Separate models were estimated for youths aged 6-11 years and youths aged 12-17 years」。结果逐字:「There was a 0.18 per 100,000 youths per month (slope change) in the 6-11 age group. There was an immediate 38.5 per 100,000 youths change ... and a sustained 6.5 per 100,000 per month (slope) change in the 12-17 age group.」——无正负号、无 CI。非开放获取(isOpenAccess=N, inEPMC=N, 无 PMCID)。

Psychiatric Services 2017 原始文献已定位:Stewart C, Crawford PM, Simon GE.「Changes in Coding of Suicide Attempts or Self-Harm With Transition From ICD-9 to ICD-10」Psychiatr Serv 2017;68(3):215;PMID 27903145;DOI 10.1176/appi.ps.201600450;为 Datapoints 专栏一页文,PubMed 与 Europe PMC 均标注 “No abstract available”。机构为 Group Health Research Institute(西雅图)与 Kaiser Permanente Northwest(波特兰)——与 (b) 同属 MHRN 体系,两条证据并非独立来源。Semantic Scholar TLDR:「The transition from ICD-9-CM to ICD10-CM may affect research, surveillance, and quality improvement related to preventing suicidal behavior and should be considered when interpreting trends during this period.」

USPSTF 原始建议(https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/depression-in-children-and-adolescents-screening-2009):发布日期 2009-03-15;12–18 岁 B 级,逐字为「The USPSTF recommends screening of adolescents (12-18 years of age) for major depressive disorder (MDD) when systems are in place to ensure accurate diagnosis, psychotherapy (cognitive-behavioral or interpersonal), and follow-up」;7–11 岁为 I 级(证据不足)。可证 “2011 建议” 为误。

NSDUH 2021 详表(https://www.samhsa.gov/data/report/2021-nsduh-detailed-tables)逐字:「Unlike previous NSDUH detailed tables, there are no trend tables comparing estimates to previous years for 2021」,原因「changes in survey methodology mean the indicators are not comparable to past NSDUH estimates」。直接反驳 (c) 中「匿名调查不受伪影影响」的无限定表述。

Ungdata 论文摘要逐字(Europe PMC EXT_ID:39370997,开放获取 PMC11578914;PubMed https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39370997/):Nilsen SA, Stormark KM, Bang L, Brunborg GS, Larsen M, Breivik K.「Time trends in adolescent depressive symptoms from 2010 to 2019 in Norway: real increase or artifacts of measurements?」Psychol Med 2024;54(14):3949–3961。逐字要点:「560 712 responses from adolescents aged 13 to 19 years」;「Depressive symptoms were measured with the Kandel and Davies' six-item Depressive Mood Inventory」;「Across most conditions, the instrument was found measurement invariant across time. The few noninvariant parameters detected had negligible impact on trend estimates. From 2014, latent mean depressive symptom scores increased among girls. For boys, a U shaped pattern was detected, whereby an initial decrease in symptoms was followed by an increase from 2016. Larger issues of noninvariance were found across age in girls and between genders.」;结论「the notion that changed reporting of symptoms has been an important driver of secular trends in depressive symptoms was not supported」。

关键反证(用于校正 (b) 的因果叙事):JHR 论文对 Stewart 等 2017 的转述逐字为「The adoption of the ICD-10 in October 2015 has been the focus of previous research that showed it increased the number of injury and poisoning visits coded as self-harm and decreased the number of visits with 'undetermined intent.' The net result was that the total number of visits involving intentional self-harm remained largely unchanged around the October 2015 adoption point」。即 2015-10 的净效应被描述为“基本不变”,与把 2015-10 说成蓄意自伤率大幅跳升的读法冲突。
unresolved: Psychiatric Services 2017 的引语「almost certainly represent artifacts of coding changes」无法逐字核到一手。该 Datapoints 无摘要,出版社 HTML 与 PDF 均返回 403(ps.psychiatryonline.org/doi/10.1176/appi.ps.201600450 及 /doi/pdf/ 同 DOI),web.archive.org 被本环境屏蔽,Semantic Scholar 存档 PDF 已 301 到无正文的落地页,fatcat API 连接被拒,CORE 403,Europe PMC 全文检索对 “artifacts of coding changes”/“represent artifacts of coding”/“artifact of coding changes” 均 0 命中。已尝试 7 条独立路径(PubMed、Europe PMC、Semantic Scholar、scholar.archive.org、fatcat、CORE、Unpaywall→出版社)。在能逐字核到之前,不应把该引语当作可引用证据。
Academic Pediatrics 2026 中 38.5、6.5、0.18 三个估计的正负号与置信区间。摘要不含符号,全文非开放获取(无 PMCID、inEPMC=N),ScienceDirect 403。虽然同组 2017 年研究提示 ICD-10 切换会提高 self-harm 编码计数(方向向上更可能),但这是推断而非一手核对。
